answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 20 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The falcon register is checked at draw time, thread lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 20 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A 52 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
